name: bitlogin-monorepo
description: BitLogin — static, relay-backed portable Nostr account protocol and embeddable login widget

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bitlogin/core && npm run build -w @bitlogin/widget
scripts.build:demo: npm run build && npm run build -w @bitlogin/demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bitlogin/core && npm run typecheck -w @bitlogin/widget
scripts.security:ci: npm run build:demo && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run security:audit
